dynamic.name: search_memory
dynamic.description: Search caller-bound memory when prior project or user context may matter. Returns compact hits with a typed sourceLookup; use those fields for source expansion when a summary is not enough. Query is text; vectorization is internal.

query.description: Text query; hits include sourceLookup for expansion.

dynamic.name: get_memory_sources
dynamic.description: Fetch source snippets by projection id, observation id, or compact ref, after a memory-search result or startup memory. Missing and cross-namespace ids both return an empty list. An ambiguous ref sets ambiguousRef with empty sources and up to four candidates; candidateCount and truncated say how many exist. That empty sources is not no memory: pick a candidate and cite its own id.

projectionId.description: Projection hit id from memory search.

observationId.description: Observation hit id from memory search.

dynamic.name: save_observation
dynamic.description: Save a durable learned fact or decision as candidate private memory. Returns its id and fingerprint; identity, scope, state, origin, and fingerprint are runtime-bound.

dynamic.name: save_preference
dynamic.description: Save a stable user instruction or preference as active private preference memory; no text-prefix parsing.

dynamic.name: session_identity_refresh
dynamic.description: Refresh the effective identity for the current or an exact same-project session from online storage. Codex resumes the existing thread with refreshed baseInstructions on its next turn so the new identity remains prefix-cacheable.

target.description: Exact session name; defaults to the current session.

dynamic.name: verification_machine_list
dynamic.description: List long-lived verification machines authorized for the current user and project. Records use stable IDs; aliases may be renamed without breaking references.

dynamic.name: verification_machine_set
dynamic.description: Create or update a user/project verification-machine authorization. Controlled nodes bind their canonical nodeId; SSH binds an existing stable aliasId and never uploads credentials. Supply id to rename/update an existing record.

dynamic.name: verification_machine_remove
dynamic.description: Remove a verification-machine authorization by stable verificationMachineId.

dynamic.name: verification_machine_verify
dynamic.description: Non-destructively verify one authorized machine by stable ID. Controlled nodes recheck current access, online state and exec permission. SSH rechecks that the associated aliasId still exists; it does not test connectivity.

dynamic.name: peer_audit_reply
dynamic.description: Audit receipt (not task pairs); binds session/task/assignment/attempt/revision.

dynamic.name: delegation_reply
dynamic.description: Submit an append-only reply. Daemon authenticates the current session against the durable delegation/assignment; no token.

dynamic.name: send_list_targets
dynamic.description: List siblings; current caller session and stopped sessions are excluded; if this returns no items, none match. Omit executionPool for all; primary/economy filter canonical live pool members.

executionPool.description: Optional primary/economy filter; omit for all siblings.

dynamic.name: session_runtime_identity_get
dynamic.description: Return only the bound caller runtime identity; model metadata is evidence, not authority.

dynamic.name: session_restart
dynamic.description: Restart an exact existing current-project session; never creates one. Default resumes prior conversation. reset=true keeps the session but starts over.

dynamic.name: session_model
dynamic.description: Get or switch an exact session model and thinking level. Omit/empty both to list current model, thinking, and supported choices; set either or both to switch (model applies before thinking).

model.description: Model id to switch to; empty/omitted keeps the current model.

thinking.description: Thinking/effort level to switch to; empty/omitted keeps the current level.

dynamic.name: send_message
dynamic.description: Send to an exact send_list_targets target; Callers and labels are invalid targets. Existing-task continuations MUST append (default), with durable FIFO fallback; queue always uses FIFO for new work. Returns delivered/queued/failed status.

target.description: Exact target; omit only for autoProvision.

filePath.description: Local identity file path. Relative paths resolve from the caller project; absolute paths are allowed for session-scoped startup identity.

identity.description: Startup identity for an auto-provisioned Agent. Provide exactly one of content or filePath.

audit.description: Audit metadata; requires reply and exact target.

dynamic.name: send_stop
dynamic.description: Stop an exact sibling active turn; queued messages remain and the caller is invalid.

dynamic.name: cron_create_self
dynamic.description: Preferred self-wakeup for the current session; Identity is automatic. Recurring is default, until_complete is bounded; minimum 5 minutes.

dynamic.name: cron_update_self
dynamic.description: Update current-session self-wakeup by id.

dynamic.name: cron_cancel_self
dynamic.description: Cancel self-wakeup; recurring needs force=true, while until_complete may self-cancel.

dynamic.name: cron_create
dynamic.description: Schedule cross-session send; use cron_create_self for this session. Minimum 5 minutes.

targetRole.description: Source role; defaults to project brain.

targetSessionName.description: Source session; target resolves among its siblings and cannot be itself.

action.description: Send action: {type:"send", target, message, reply?, broadcast?, idempotencyKey?}.

expiresAt.description: Epoch-ms/offset-ISO, ≤90 days; affects future sends only.

dynamic.name: cron_list
dynamic.description: List scoped cron jobs.

dynamic.name: cron_update
dynamic.description: Update cross-session cron; minimum 5 minutes.

targetSessionName.description: Replacement source session; target resolves among its siblings.

action.description: Replacement send action; other action types are rejected.

expiresAt.description: Replacement epoch-ms/offset-ISO; affects future sends only.

force.description: Required to change recurring to until_complete.

dynamic.name: cron_delete
dynamic.description: Delete cron by id; recurring jobs require force.

force.description: Required for agent deletion of recurring jobs.

dynamic.name: resolve_alias
dynamic.description: Resolve an exact user-scoped alias value by case-sensitive NFC name; distinct from memory. Unknown names return found:false with alias_not_found. Use list_aliases, save_alias, or delete_alias for other operations.

dynamic.name: list_aliases
dynamic.description: Search or list user-scoped alias METADATA ONLY (name, description, tags, timestamps); values are excluded. Use resolve_alias for one value.

dynamic.name: save_alias
dynamic.description: Upsert a user-scoped alias name to an exact value with optional metadata. Existing names overwrite; server validation is authoritative. The value is inserted verbatim later and omitted from the response.

name.description: NFC letters/digits/._-, ≤20 code points; overwrites existing.

value.description: Exact inserted value; nonempty, ≤500 code points, no NUL.

dynamic.name: delete_alias
dynamic.description: Delete a user-scoped alias by name. Missing names return deleted:false with alias_not_found, not an error.

dynamic.name: mcp_tool_search
dynamic.description: Use mcp_tool_search for one exact IM.codes tool/group. All are backend-active. After list_changed refetch every tools/list page; if the target stays absent, call again with exact fallbackCall { name, arguments }.

query.description: Exact tool name, task phrase, or group:<id>.

activate.description: Legacy name; defaults true and publishes a bounded schema view without changing service activation.

Brain-only: applies to every session under the project, including the Brain's own future restarts and every sub-session — there is nothing separate to set per sub-session. Managed Skills are a separate concept and stay injected either way.

enabled.description: true to enable (the default), false to disable.

all.description: Refresh every affected session at once instead of just target. Defaults to true for user/project scope, false for session scope.

static_full.name: list_machines
static_full.description: Discover canonical controlled-node nodeIds or inspect advisory availability; do not call it as a preflight when an exact nodeId or ^^(nodeId) is known. Action routes check live state. FULL nodes only.

includeOffline.description: Include offline/exec-disabled machines; default false, advisory only.

static_full.name: exec_remote
static_full.description: Run a shell/CLI command or executable (for example ipmitool.exe) on a controlled node in session 0/SYSTEM; such requests MUST use exec_remote, not GUI OCU. Use shell_session1 only for active-user semantics. Pass a canonical 10-digit nodeId or complete ^^(nodeId) without calling list_machines first; deprecated noncanonical legacy ref_name is migration-only. The command is private execution input: NEVER repeat or summarize its text in an assistant reply, delegation card, or dispatch claim; record only the task dispatch and bounded outcome facts. not_dispatched is retry-safe; dispatched_no_result may have run. FULL nodes only.

machine.description: 10-digit nodeId or ^^(nodeId); legacy alias is compatibility-only. No list_machines preflight.

static_full.name: send_file_to_machine
static_full.description: Direct→relay file send to a canonical 10-digit nodeId or ^^(nodeId), with deprecated noncanonical legacy ref_name compatibility only. Resolve without list_machines. Reports mode; Relay≤2GiB; unsafe/credential paths rejected.

machine.description: 10-digit nodeId or ^^(nodeId); legacy alias is compatibility-only.

static_full.name: fetch_file_from_machine
static_full.description: Direct-then-relay file fetch from a canonical 10-digit nodeId or ^^(nodeId), without list_machines; deprecated noncanonical legacy ref_name is compatibility-only. Reports mode; atomic commit; overwrite=false. FULL nodes only.

machine.description: 10-digit nodeId or ^^(nodeId); legacy alias is compatibility-only.

static_full.name: computer_use_docs
static_full.description: Return one focused Computer Use documentation topic. FULL nodes only.

static_full.name: computer_use_call
static_full.description: GUI/browser control locally or remotely. Do not use GUI OCU for a shell/CLI/executable request. A helper failure does not mean the machine is unauthorized or uncontrollable. Use shell_session1 only for active-user semantics. Prefer browser_open/browser_snapshot. Pass a canonical 10-digit nodeId or complete ^^(nodeId) marker without calling list_machines first; deprecated noncanonical legacy ref_name is compatibility-only. GUI max 120000, shell_session1 max 900000. FULL nodes only.

machine.description: 10-digit nodeId, ^^(nodeId), legacy alias, or local/self; no list_machines preflight.

arguments.description: Method arguments. Windows coordinate drag additionally accepts duration_ms=100..20000.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout ms; GUI/browser max 120000, shell_session1 max 900000.

value.description: Exact inserted value; nonempty, ≤500 code points, no NUL.

static_full.name: delete_alias
static_full.description: Delete a user-scoped alias by name. Missing names return deleted:false with alias_not_found, not an error.

static_full.description: List or search pinned messages accessible to the current user on this server. Defaults to the current session; scope=all searches all still-authorized sessions. Returns bounded previews; use get_message_pin for full text.

scope.description: Defaults to current; all spans authorized sessions on this server.

query.description: Literal case-insensitive text or session-name substring.
